'''Docking Bay 155''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]].<ref name="votf" />

Sometime in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] went to Bastion in search of a copy of the [[Caamas Document]]. They left Calrissian's [[Starship/Legends|ship]] [[Lady Luck/Legends|''Lady Luck'']] in Docking Bay 155.<ref name="votf" />
